injuries.detail: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against Utah.
Biberovic (heel) is listed as out for Monday's game against Sacramento.
Lively (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Kings.
McConnell is questionable for Monday's game against the Mavericks due to a right hamstring strain.
Haliburton (hamstring) is progressing well but does not have a timetable to return, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.
Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.
